combos.name: Firestorm
combos.how: A fire jutsu passing through an ally's wind gust (within 20 ticks) grows: x1.5 power, x1.5 radius, burning doubled

combos.name: Storm Surge
combos.how: Lightning into soaked targets or a water jutsu's area: shocks everyone in it (stun 10 ticks, chains 4)

combos.name: Lava Bullets
combos.how: Fire through Earth Dragon Bullet's mud: lava bullets (x1.4, burning)

combos.name: Mudslide
combos.how: Water over Mud River: twice as long, enemies stuck (bound 30)

combos.name: Gale Rain
combos.how: Wind through a water wave: needles of rain at long range (x1.3, soaked, chilled)

combos.name: Thunder Gust
combos.how: Even natures that oppose each other combine with timing: a perfect-timed (5 ticks) lightning through wind spreads into a 6-block arc

combos.name: Magma Wall
combos.how: Fire into an earth wall: the wall glows and burns anyone touching it
